crossRefs.note: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the…
One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the…
He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

parallels.note: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

people.name: Demetrius
people.line: Silversmith who opposed Paul in Ephesus

translations.web: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
translations.bsb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
translations.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
translations.asv: Demetrius hath the witness of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness: and thou knowest that our witness is true.
